entities.label: Story slice
entities.definition: User-recognizable end-to-end increment with acceptance checks and exclusions.

entities.label: Story map
entities.definition: Ordered user activities and tasks; separates existing capability from gaps.

entities.label: WIP limit
entities.definition: Explicit limit on simultaneous unfinished work.

entities.label: Cost of delay
entities.definition: Qualitative or evidenced economic consequence of deferring a slice.

entities.label: Forecast
entities.definition: Conditional prediction, never a velocity commitment.
